description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'exclude_patterns' functionality in Git's ref store. It sets up a testing environment, defines various test cases to verify correct behavior of ref exclusion, and includes assertions to verify the index of jumps made during ref operations.

methods.name: for_each_ref__exclude
methods.description: Function to list references excluding certain patterns, using 'for-each-ref' with exclusion parameters.

methods.name: for_each_ref
methods.description: Function to list references with a specified format.

methods.name: assert_jumps
methods.description: Function to assert the number of jumps made during ref operations, depending on the format.

methods.name: assert_no_jumps
methods.description: Function to assert that no jumps occurred during the operation.
